description: Election Commission - Declare that K. D. C. K. Weerasinghe and S. Punchihewa as a members of the Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a local government body (Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha) due to resignations, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including party nominations and declarations of selected members by the Returning Officer, which falls squarely under election-related matters.
